'''Marlow''' is a male student from the Department of Light Energy Sciences, talking with his classmate, '''Dahl'''.
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Dahl''' Did you hear about the people from Agro Wing who ended up in the infirmary after eating some mushrooms the other day?
:;'''Dahl''' [[Luuk Herssen|Dr. Herssen]] and his medical team were swamped the entire afternoon.

==Dialogue==
:'''Marlow:''' Just the infirmary? What's so surprising about that?
:'''Marlow:''' They eat those hybrid plants they grow themselves all the time.
:'''Dahl:''' Yeah, I saw them throwing around corn cobs the size of my arm yesterday.
:'''Dahl:''' No wonder they wanted to set up their own department...
:'''Marlow:''' Anyway, just try not to eat anything they ask you to willy-nilly.
{{Dialogue End}}
